While the coat color and ear feathering are correct, the head shape is a defining characteristic of the subclass. The fine-grained classifier predicted 'Blenheim spaniel' with high confidence, likely relying on the coat pattern and general spaniel features, but this is a false positive regarding the specific morphological requirements. Since the most prominent visible subject fails the key anatomical checkpoint, the alignment score is significantly penalized, though not bottomed out because other features (eyes, ears, coat) are present.
